findings.claim: The client-secret verifier can silently pass service-role material in common example environment files because it only scans a narrow extension allowlist.
findings.evidence: The plan acceptance requires "client examples never expose service-role credentials," but `clientSourceExtensions` only includes `.dart/.html/.js/.jsx/.json/.md/.mjs/.rs/.ts/.tsx`, and `scanClientExamples` collects files only when `clientSourceExtensions.has(extname(path))`, so files such as `examples/**/.env`, `.env.example`, `.env.local`, `.toml`, `.yaml`, or `.yml` are excluded from the reported 297-file scan.
findings.suggested_fix: Scan all text-like files under `examples` by default with explicit binary/large-file exclusions, or at minimum include env/config extensions and dotfiles such as `.env`, `.env.example`, `.env.local`, `.toml`, `.yaml`, and `.yml`.
